title: Finite torsors
statement:
For a finite abelian group $M$, an $M$-torsor on $Y_{\Et}$ is a finite locally
constant sheaf $P$ with an $M$-action such that $M\times P\to P\times_YP$ is
an isomorphism. Write

$$
 \operatorname{Tor}^1(Y,M)
$$

for the pointed set of isomorphism classes of $M$-torsors on $Y_{\Et}$.
lead_note: 2026-10-10 L: too weak as stated (found by the worker of thm-galois-lc-etale): an M-torsor must also have sections locally (Stacks 03AH), otherwise the empty sheaf is a torsor; thm-galois-lc-etale reads it with that condition (as def-sc-gm-torsor). To be corrected at its split.
